en-US.name: Contract Review Team
en-US.summary: A six-member contract review team: intake gating, clause structuring, risk scanning and jurisdiction checks, closed by an independent reviewer who re-verifies against the source text before reporting
en-US.description: Six members collaborate in a fixed chain, with each step judged by observable outcomes: input coverage, source evidence, real receipts and explicit gaps. The Lead starts with a minimal case ledger, then runs intake, clause facts, parallel jurisdiction and risk checks, and an independent review. A non-critical capability failure is recorded as capability debt and does not become a fabricated conclusion. The output supports review work and is not legal advice; a qualified person must review it before use.

zh-CN.name: 合同审查团队
zh-CN.summary: 六名成员分工的合同审查团队：输入治理、条款结构化、风险识别、法域合规，最后由独立复核成员回原文重新取证再出报告
zh-CN.description: 六名成员按固定链路协作，但每一步只要求可验证的工作结果：文件覆盖、原文证据、真实回执和明确欠账。Lead 先建立最小登记与覆盖表，再按输入治理、条款事实、法域与风险并行、独立复核的顺序推进；单个工具能力不足时记录 capability_debt 并降级，不伪造结论。产出是供审阅使用的辅助材料，不构成法律意见，必须由具备资质的人员复核。
